answer: In a decentralized AI agent economy, cryptographic proof-of-stake serves as a robust defense against Sybil attacks by requiring agents to lock capital as an economic anchor. Operating like a secure digital garden where computational rights must be cultivated through staked resources, the system treats any unbonded identity as an invalid relic. An attacker attempting to flood the network with fake nodes faces a compounding financial cost, as each autonomous agent must independently provision scarce native tokens, making large-scale identity replication economically prohibitive.
